PC: Perform initial primary survey (including ABCDE, GCS)
Evaluate and manage altered mental status
Perform secondary survey and recognize potential ingestions (alcohol (ETOH)/drugs)
Consider naloxone dose at 0.1 mg/kg/dose, may repeat every 2-3 minutes as needed
MK: Obtain and interpret laboratory studies, including point of care glucose
Discussion amongst participants about likely diagnosis and appropriate management
Team to discuss treatment for THC intoxication
SBP: Recognize need for a full resuscitation team when a patient presents with altered mental status of unknown etiology.
Sign patient out to the PICU or neurology confederate.
If patient remains lethargic, consider admission for general monitoring
ICS: Division of labor to accomplish multiple tasks simultaneously
Open communication with the parent even if there is uncertainty
Designate leadership and team member roles to ensure coordinated team functioning.
Use brief or huddle to create a shared mental model for the working diagnosis and management plan.
